params.cutoff: Sets the filter frequency, 20 Hz to 18 kHz across the control. Most of the travel sits low, where sweeps are musical.
params.resonance: Emphasises the frequencies at the cutoff. Q 0.5 to 20, flat until roughly a third of the way up, squelchy near the top.
params.morph: Blends the filter shape continuously: fully down is lowpass, centred is bandpass, fully up is highpass.
params.filter_attack: How long the envelope takes to sweep the cutoff to its peak after a note starts.
params.filter_decay: How long the envelope takes to fall from the peak to the sustain level.
params.filter_sustain: How much of the sweep the envelope holds while a note is down.
params.filter_release: How long the envelope takes to fall back to the cutoff after the last note ends.
params.env_amount: How far the envelope sweeps the cutoff, in octaves. Negative sweeps down instead of up.
